critical_code_review_comments: reconciliation.py bucket 4 soup rule now correctly requires BOTH sodium_mg > 3000 AND a dish-name regex match (soup|consomme|stock|shorba|broth or bare rasam). Verified: solid dishes minced-meat-pancake (Na=7413) and spaghetti-bolognese (Na=8038) no longer trip the rescale, while all three real-soup regression IDs still rescale to 30g.

reconciliation.CONCENTRATED_BASE_IDS is a proper 32-entry allowlist and is cleanly disjoint from the 7-entry tier_override set (Mongo intersection==0). This keeps the 'flagged for resourcing' bucket auditable and distinct from clinical exception overrides.

BAGHAR_SPICE_PATTERN r'^\s*\w+\s+seeds?\s+baghar\s*$' correctly requires a 'seeds baghar' ending. Confirmed via API: onion-tomato-baghar and green-gram-whole-with-baghar (both containing 'baghar' but not '<x> seeds baghar') are left unrescaled at 150g.

server.py switch from update_one($set) to replace_one is the right choice for idempotent seeding since it clears stale keys (e.g. auto_rescaled) from earlier looser runs. No stale auto_rescaled=true seen on the four dishes T1-T3.
